headline: Consent, pre-commit red-teaming, and exact demand hydration now form one self-validating player-decision boundary.

items.title: Bounded feedback publication
items.evidence: Local receipts remain private by default; one explicit choice and versioned disclosure receipt bound every public row and field.

items.title: Architect Plan Rehearsal
items.evidence: One shared desktop/mobile review joins intent, pressure, promise, identity, and strongest source-derived counter-signal before any mutation.

items.title: Demand-owned tab hydration
items.evidence: All 14 public tabs declare exact domains with authority-scoped caching, coalescing, invalidation, and retry-visible failure receipts.

items.title: Static input resilience
items.evidence: Challenge payloads reject total size and bounded typed fields before base64 or JSON work while preserving valid VSFC1 codes.

items.title: Truthful canonical verification
items.evidence: Node 24 shards terminate only after complete TAP, every test file has exact shard ownership, and the final atomic receipt proves 517/517.

followUps.title: Fresh next arc
followUps.evidence: Primary and viable second-order queues are exhausted; begin a fresh live-code audit unless external release evidence changes.

blockers.title: Hosted release evidence family
blockers.evidence: Canonical /_health is 404; HSTS/frame/CSP, delivered email, approval, exact hosted provenance, and lifecycle reconciliation remain incomplete.

honestyLedger.title: Failed gates retained
honestyLedger.evidence: Early timeouts and the initial unsharded-test failure are diagnostic non-evidence, superseded only by the full direct rerun.

honestyLedger.title: No causal or predictive claim
honestyLedger.evidence: Rehearsal challenges declared intent from existing receipts and grants no hidden bonus or outcome prediction.

honestyLedger.title: Visual claim bounded
honestyLedger.evidence: Automated 53-capture evidence is green; manual AI image inspection is not claimed because connected readers failed before opening files.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom launch
honestyLedger.evidence: Credential readiness, local builds, and route reachability are not substituted for delivered email, canonical health, approval, provenance, or lifecycle authority.
